item.title: TTT 444.5: Summah!
item.description:
Every once in a while Eric retreats to the basement, puts on his headphones and pretends he’s a DJ.

Here’s his summer 2016 mix that he put out after the summer. Some songs were played on the show, others weren’t. Have fun!
